h1: B2B Lead Generation for Exporters in Kolkata
intro: Kolkata and West Bengal's export houses lead India in leather goods (Bantala), iron castings and engineering goods (Howrah), specialty tea and agro products, jute and eco-packaging, and apparel exports. From our Mumbai HQ, we build managed cold email and LinkedIn outbound systems that connect [Kolkata](/b2b-lead-generation-kolkata) exporters directly with verified importers, distributors, and retail buyers across Europe, the US, UK, UAE, and APAC. See how we drove [2.1x higher positive replies for an engineering exporter](/case-studies/manufacturers-exporters-engineering-goods-replies) and [18 meetings in France for a packaging exporter](/case-studies/manufacturers-exporters-france-packaging).

faqs.q: Can Myntmore reach international buyers in Europe, the US, and the Middle East for Kolkata exporters?
faqs.a: Yes. We have booked verified importer, RFQ, and distributor meetings across Germany, France, the UK, the US, UAE, and Singapore for Indian manufacturers and exporters.

faqs.q: How is this different from Alibaba, IndiaMART, or export-data subscriptions?
faqs.a: Portals force you to wait for price-shoppers who message 20 factories at once. We proactively identify your exact ideal international buyers, verify the decision-maker's direct email and LinkedIn, and initiate 1-on-1 commercial conversations.

faqs.q: Can you work across specific Kolkata export clusters like Bantala leather or Howrah castings?
faqs.a: Yes. We tailor target buyer personas, certification hooks (LWG, ISO, SEDEX, BRC, Fairtrade), and sampling offers directly to your product category.

faqs.q: Are your European outbound emails GDPR-aware?
faqs.a: Yes. We run strictly B2B legitimate-interest outreach to relevant corporate buyers, include clean opt-out handling, and maintain dedicated warmed domains for strong European inbox placement.

faqs.q: How long before we start seeing international buyer replies?
faqs.a: Infrastructure, list verification, and copy take 2 weeks. Qualified importer replies and catalogue/sample calls typically start in weeks 3 to 5.
